# Cyril Lisle

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 c36 P37](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0037)</sub>
- **Origin:** Portmaris  <sub>[v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047)</sub>

## Appearance

He possesses endearing good looks and dark, dreamy eyes. He has a lovely voice and a distinct, deep, dark, velvety smile.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 c26 P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 c27 P36](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0036)_

## Personality

He has constant, polite manners and a poetic, romantic disposition. He tends to be dramatic and somber, though some find he lacks real substance and humor.

_Sources: [v3 c26 P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 c27 P36](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0036), [v3 c38 P14](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0014), [v3 c39 P2](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0002)_

## History

Cyril returned to Wexcombe to finish his Junior year and complete his Arts degree after spending two years in Europe with his ill mother. He met Nell Harcourt in the park during a rainstorm when his umbrella rescued hers, and he subsequently began courting her by sending flowers and poetry. Throughout his time at college, he pursued Nell ardently, writing her sonnets and letters twice a week, leading many to anticipate their engagement. Though his mother and sister Aline were initially cool, his sister Dorothy warmly supported the acquaintance. After Convocation, Cyril proposed to Nell in the harbor park pavilion where they first met. Surprised and deeply hurt when she rejected his proposal, he bade her farewell and declared that no other woman would ever have his affection, though his sister Dorothy noted he would eventually recover as he always did.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P38](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0038), [v3 c25 P44](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0044), [v3 c25 P45](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0045), [v3 c27 P36](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0036), [v3 c28 P22](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0022), [v3 c36 P24](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0024), [v3 c36 P32](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0032), [v3 c37 P31](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0031), [v3 c38 P17](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0017), [v3 c38 P18](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0018), [v3 c38 P32](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0032), [v3 c39 P4](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0004)_

## Background by volume

- his father passed away  <sub>[v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047)</sub>
- belongs to the wealthy, elite Gardner family of Portmaris  <sub>[v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047)</sub>
- completed his Freshman and Sophomore years at Wexcombe before traveling in Europe for two years due to his mother's illness  <sub>[v3 c25 P38](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0038), [v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047)</sub>

## Quotes

> I have the impression that I do not fit in anywhere so far. Two years back, I completed my Freshman and Sophomore years at Wexcombe. I have resided in Europe from that time onward. At present, I have returned so that I can complete my Arts degree.  <sub>[v3 c25 P38](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0038)</sub>

> In what way do you intend that?  <sub>[v3 c38 P20](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0020)</sub>

> What is the reason you are unable to?  <sub>[v3 c38 P22](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0022)</sub>

> Then you have merely been entertaining yourself throughout these past two years?  <sub>[v3 c38 P25](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0025)</sub>

> Well then—farewell. It is beyond my comprehension—it is impossible for me to accept that you aren't the lady I thought you were. However, upbraiding one another is useless now. No other female will ever have my affection. I am grateful to you for your companionship, if nothing else. Farewell, Nell.  <sub>[v3 c38 P32](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0032)</sub>
